title: Multi-Reference Path Tracking Control for an Agricultural Tractor with Nonlinear Model Predictive Control
description:
arXiv:2610.00057v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Guiding a tractor along a predefined reference path is a key component of precision agriculture. This study develops a path tracking controller based on Nonlinear Model Predictive Control, which incorporates multiple segments of a piecewise-linear reference path directly into the objective function.
